Ilse's message was just letting the team know her plans, so there was nothing to do except reply. I posted an acknowledgement in a thread under her message in #north-team. It says she's on the road tomorrow morning, can be reached on mobile, and that I'll point anyone looking for her to her mobile.

I checked recent #north-team messages and found nothing waiting on her. I didn't look at her calendar for tomorrow and didn't send anything else.
